title: Adnois API

listing.shortDescription: A typed, tested API foundation on AdonisJS — authentication, mail, validation and a MySQL data layer, with a Postman collection ready for integration.
listing.fullDescription: Adnois is a backend built the way backends should be: typed, tested and ready to integrate against. Built on AdonisJS with Lucid ORM, it provides authentication, role handling, MJML-powered email and VineJS validation, backed by MySQL and Redis with SMTP mail. A Postman collection ships with the repo so any frontend team can start consuming the API immediately.

cover.imageAlt: Adnois API — AdonisJS REST API Backend

closing.conclusion: Adnois delivered a typed, tested API foundation — authentication, mail and validation built on AdonisJS with a Postman collection ready for the frontend team to integrate against.
